Definition: to drive out from a possession; especially to expatriate or divorce
BiblicalUsage: 1) to drive out, expel, cast out, drive away, divorce, put away, thrust away, trouble, cast up; 1a) (Qal) to thrust out, cast out; 1b) (Niphal) to be driven away, be tossed; 1c) (Piel) to drive out, drive away; 1d) (Pual) to be thrust out
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
